name: @pipeworx/mcp-ens

tools.name: resolve_ens
tools.description: Resolve an ENS name (e.g. "vitalik.eth") to its Ethereum address and profile records (avatar, description, socials: twitter/github/discord/email/url). Keyless.

tools.name: reverse_ens
tools.description: Reverse-resolve an Ethereum address (0x…) to its primary ENS name and profile records. Keyless.

instructions: @pipeworx/mcp-ens forwards to the Pipeworx gateway and lists only the ens pack's tools. Set PIPEWORX_META_TOOLS=1 to also list ask_pipeworx and the other gateway-wide tools.
